diagnosis: The billing invoice route uses bun:sqlite to fetch invoice records by invoiceNumber without verifying that customer_id matches the authenticated user's organization (req.user.customerId). An attacker can enumerate sequential invoice numbers to extract billing totals, itemized services, tax IDs, and confidential invoice PDF filenames for other customer accounts.
exploit_request:
GET /api/billing/invoices/INV-2026-08819/details HTTP/1.1
Host: billing.cloudsaas.io
Cookie: user_session=sess_customer_gamma_99
